never: join on a name or an amount
correct a record without a person's acceptance

provider_block.job: two systems say the same thing about the same job

with_us.note: No hosted step. The production check runs over the business's own two sources with a person on every correction.

checks.title: A person writes down which two records are compared, never a guess
Records are matched on the shared reference, never on a name or an amount
Records that agree stay quiet, and a mismatch is shown side by side, never corrected
A fix is proposed with both values, and saved only after a named person accepts it
A record missing from the other system is flagged with a reason and an owner
Any allowance for rounding or timing is a number a person set for each detail, never assumed
Every scheduled run reports its counts, including the all-clear
A difference over the set limit, or too many mismatches, reaches a named person in the same run
Every accepted fix keeps both original values and who accepted it
For any shared reference, every run, difference and fix can be looked up
It keeps working if the person who built it leaves
